title: Senior Ruby Developer
description:
Location: Remote LATAM

Engagement: Part-time Contractor

Start Date: End of November

Duration: 2 sprints, with strong potential for continued work until June 2026

Schedule: ~25 hours per week


About the Role

We’re looking for a Ruby Specialist with deep experience in Discourse to deliver a fast, clean, and production-ready P1 integration between Discourse and an existing Community application. The integration includes SSO via Okta and OIDC, group and role mapping, backend adapters, shared UI elements, webhook delivery into our analytics stack, and a smooth cutover plan.

This is a high-impact engagement supporting an active squad. You’ll work closely with backend, frontend, security, IT, and data engineering partners to unblock engineers, validate designs, and land the integration safely behind feature flags. If the initial scope goes well, the engagement is expected to extend through mid-2026.

We’re looking for someone proactive, calm under pressure, and comfortable operating in a multi-team environment where clarity and speed matter.


Responsibilities
  • Deliver the P1 Discourse to a Community application integration within two sprints
  • Implement SSO using Okta and OIDC, ensuring secure token handling and session flows
  • Create and test group and role mapping between the Community roles and Discourse groups
  • Build backend Ruby adapters for moderation, taxonomy, and role syncing, gated behind feature flags
  • Implement shared header and navigation elements for a consistent cross-platform experience
  • Create and validate webhook pipelines from Discourse into Snowflake for analytics
  • Develop a clear cutover and rollback plan, including checklists and validation steps
  • Write or review technical designs, threat models, and operational readiness docs
  • Pair with frontend and backend engineers to land adapters, UI integration, and test coverage
  • Coordinate closely with Security and IT on Okta configuration, secrets, and access policies
  • Work with Data Engineering to finalize webhook schemas, retries, and observability
  • Support sprint ceremonies, demos, and unblock teammates on integration or Ruby-related work
  • Ensure all deliverables are tested, documented, and ready for production


Requirements
  • 5+ years of experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails
  • Strong hands-on experience customizing and extending Discourse
  • Deep understanding of SSO flows (OIDC, OAuth2, Okta) and secure token handling
  • Proven experience delivering integrations behind feature flags or staged rollouts
  • Comfortable writing technical designs, threat models, and operational runbooks
  • Solid experience with APIs, background jobs, webhooks, and data syncing
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in distributed teams
  • Advanced English


Nice to Have
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar analytics platforms
  • Familiarity with frontend integration of shared headers or cross-app navigation
  • Prior work in enterprise environments that require coordination across IT, Security, and Data teams
  • Experience building rollback strategies and production cutover plans
  • Hands-on experience with DevOps or infrastructure supporting Ruby services

﻿

Why Join

This is a critical, high-visibility integration that will significantly impact how users navigate between Discourse and the Community platform within a large US company. You’ll collaborate with a focused, friendly, and fast-moving team, and you’ll own a deliverable that immediately impacts thousands of users. The work is scoped, essential, and a strong performer will be invited to continue supporting the platform through June 2026.

If you enjoy solving complex integration puzzles, delivering reliable Ruby code, and helping cross-functional teams move faster, this project is an excellent fit.

Sobre a Motivus


Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Objetivo do Cargo:


O Analista de Performance & Insights é o contador de histórias com dados da equipe de Marketing Direto, responsável por transformar resultados de campanhas e tendências de dados de primeira mão (1P) em insights acionáveis para o negócio . Esse profissional impulsiona a melhoria contínua ao medir o desempenho de CRM & Loyalty, identificar oportunidades de otimização e criar relatórios claros e prontos para tomada de decisão pelos stakeholders internos.

Com sólido conhecimento de modelos de dados de consumidores e relacionamentos entre entidades , essa pessoa conecta informações de diferentes fontes, canais e públicos para identificar os principais fatores de sucesso. É responsável por definir, monitorar e interpretar KPIs relacionados ao crescimento de dados 1P, engajamento do consumidor e efetividade das campanhas, garantindo que os esforços da equipe sejam mensuráveis, impactantes e alinhados às prioridades do negócio .

O cargo exige compreensão funcional de infraestrutura de dados de marketing e conceitos técnicos , permitindo colaboração eficiente com equipes de analytics, CDP e ativação — garantindo que os insights sejam confiáveis, contextualizados e incorporados às decisões estratégicas .


Principais Responsabilidades:


Dados, Mensuração & Otimização:

  • Definir, monitorar e evoluir KPIs-chave relacionados a campanhas de CRM & Loyalty, coleta de dados 1P, engajamento do consumidor e conversão.
  • Realizar análises detalhadas de performance de jornadas, e-mails, promoções e programas de dados 1P, traduzindo resultados em insights acionáveis.
  • Identificar tendências de performance e oportunidades de melhoria nos canais (e-mail, push, mídia paga) e fazer recomendações estratégicas para otimização das táticas de ativação.
  • Construir e manter scorecards de campanhas, benchmarks e frameworks de pós-campanha que padronizem a mensuração nos mercados.
  • Garantir que os insights sejam contextualizados, relevantes e facilmente compreendidos por stakeholders não técnicos (ex.: equipes de marca, conteúdo, CRM).


Suporte Estratégico:

  • Atuar como líder analítico da equipe de Marketing Direto, contribuindo para revisões de performance trimestrais e anuais, previsões e planejamento estratégico.
  • Colaborar com líderes de CRM & Ativação de Dados para incorporar aprendizados de dados em estratégias de segmentação, design de jornadas e lógica de público.
  • Monitorar campanhas em andamento para detectar sinais precoces de performance ou problemas, propondo ajustes em tempo real quando necessário.
  • Traduzir perguntas de negócio em hipóteses baseadas em dados , trabalhando com analytics ou equipes de dados para validar e explorar.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de melhores práticas de mensuração, modelagem de uplift e frameworks de experimentação .


Experiência & Competências Necessárias:


  • 5+ anos de experiência em análise de dados, relatórios de performance ou analytics de marketing , idealmente em CRM, Loyalty ou Engajamento do Consumidor.
  • Forte entendimento de estratégias de dados 1P , métricas de CRM (open rate, CTR, CVR, etc.) e acompanhamento de performance de campanhas de lifecycle.
  • Habilidade em interpretar dados de marketing e transformar conjuntos complexos de dados em insights acionáveis para o negócio .
  • Confortável trabalhando com modelos de dados relacionais e compreendendo relações entre entidades em plataformas como Salesforce CDP ou bancos de dados CRM.
  • Experiência com ferramentas analíticas (Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Google Analytics, etc.) para gerar visualizações e relatórios claros .
  • Capacidade comprovada de comunicar insights de forma clara e confiante a stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Perfil proativo, com forte visão de negócios e curiosidade para questionar suposições e identificar oportunidades.
  • Inglês avançado


Qualificações Desejáveis:


  • Experiência em CPG, varejo ou indústrias orientadas a loyalty , com alto volume de campanhas diretas ao consumidor.
  • Familiaridade com Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce CDP ou plataformas similares.
  • Experiência com testes A/B, frameworks de experimentação ou análise de lift incremental .
  • Compreensão de métricas do funil de marketing, tendências de engajamento e análise de cohort.
  • Experiência em segmentação de consumidores, modelagem de retenção ou análise de atribuição é um diferencial.



Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?


  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo: Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente: Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores


  • Cultura de Inovação: Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade: Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.

title: IT Infrastructure Lead
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION


IT Infrastructure Lead

Brazil

Duration: 1 Year + Possibility of extension

Full time - Onsite


We are seeking a hands-on IT Infrastructure Lead to coordinate a small team responsible for core infrastructure operations and improvements. This role emphasizes leadership, planning, and cross-functional collaboration across global teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and guide a small infrastructure team across compute, storage, and network domains.
  • Coordinate infrastructure tasks, timelines, and dependencies; ensure alignment with technical goals.
  • Facilitate change windows, maintenance schedules, and upgrades with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Track and escalate risks, issues, and blockers with clear context and recommended actions.
  • Maintain documentation, dashboards, and status reports for leadership and technical teams.
  • Support vendor coordination for hardware logistics, remote hands, and service delivery.
  • Ensure compliance with change management and security protocols.
  • Organize and lead team standups, working sessions, and stakeholder updates.

Preferred Qualifications


3 to 5 years strong experience in IT INFRASTRUCTURE

  • Experience leading infrastructure initiatives in hybrid or co-managed environments.
  • Solid understanding of servers, virtualization, storage, networking, DNS, and monitoring.
  • Proficiency with tools like Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, or Smartsheet.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage priorities across time zones and work independently.
  • Nice to Have Familiarity with ITIL, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices.
  • Experience with CMDB and inventory tools.

title: Engineer Manager
description:
Remoto | Grupo SBF | Ecossistema do Esporte


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engineering Manager para liderar nossas equipes de engenharia com foco em excelência técnica, impacto nos negócios e desenvolvimento de pessoas. Essa é uma posição estratégica de liderança, com responsabilidade direta sobre entregas, pessoas e processos.

Se você tem paixão por formar times de alta performance, toma decisões baseadas em dados e sabe equilibrar visão técnica e foco em pessoas, essa vaga pode ser sua próxima jornada!


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia em posições de liderança à frente de mais de um contexto;
  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Histórico de entregas com impacto real (eficiência, performance, redução de custo ou aumento de satisfação);
  • Conhecimento avançado em arquitetura de software, sistemas distribuídos e metodologias ágeis ;
  • Familiaridade com métricas de times de engenharia (DORA Metrics ou similares);
  • Experiência com sistemas críticos e em escala ;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e empática ;
  • Capacidade de liderar e desenvolver times diversos , promovendo um ambiente seguro , colaborativo e de crescimento ;
  • Visão sistêmica e foco em resolver problemas complexos com inovação e senso de urgência.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar times de engenharia, garantindo entregas estratégicas com qualidade e alinhamento aos objetivos da empresa;
  • Atuar próximo a Produto, Design, Segurança e Infraestrutura para garantir sinergia e integração nas entregas;
  • Ser responsável por desenvolvimento de pessoas, feedbacks, mentoring e formação de cultura;
  • Participar de decisões técnicas relevantes, com foco em escalabilidade, confiabilidade e performance;
  • Gerenciar orçamento, riscos e priorizações, com capacidade de adaptação e liderança em momentos de crise;
  • Promover boas práticas de engenharia, cultura de experimentação e aprendizagem contínua.


✨ Diferenciais que somam pontos:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência anterior em e-commerce ou ambientes de larga escala;
  • Participação em iniciativas de transformação organizacional ou melhoria contínua;
  • Publicações técnicas, participação em comunidades, eventos ou contribuições open source;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de segurança (OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001) e atuação com Security Champions.

Se interessou?

description:

We’re hiring a Creative Strategist with heavy direct response experience.

You must have lived and breathed direct response advertising and VSL-style creative—knowing the beats, pacing, proof, and psychology that drive conversions. This is a hands-on IC role with pod-level ownership (no formal people management).

WHAT WILL YOU DO?


Direct Response Strategy / Briefing / Analysis

● Develop a creative strategy by offer, funnel, and awareness stage; publish weekly test plans.

● Outline 2–3 minute VSL-style ads (problem, agitation, solution, proof, CTA) and collaborate with copy on scripting.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 90 DAYS)

● 100–200 DR ads shipped weekly , >98% QA pass rate .

● Iterations launched within 24–48 hours of insights , increasing win rate.

● Faster time-to-first-winner and more winners per 50 launches.

● A standardized system for DR briefs (VSL, creator, iteration) used by the team.

● Clean DAM and clear creative pipeline visible to Growth/Media .


MUST-HAVES

● 3+ years in direct response creative strategy, ideally in high-spend environments ($1MM+/mo).

● Deep experience with VSL-style ads : structure, beats, proof, pacing, CTA flow.

● Proven ability to ship 100–200 ads weekly across VSLs, short-form, and UGC.

● Strong post-production literacy (Premiere/Final Cut/AE basics) for precise DR feedback.

● Track record of writing/briefing iterations and content creators for DR assets .

● Data-driven mindset; you live in Hook/Hold/CTR/CPC/CPA/ROAS.

● Detail-oriented; errors don’t slip past you.

● Clear communicator who pushes creative toward DR performance.


NICE-TO-HAVES

● Health, beauty, or OTC-adjacent experience.

● Amazon and TikTok Shop creative systems.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English


Position: Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Work Hours: Must have overlap with U.S. Central Time

Start Date: Immediate

Contract Type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

Duration: 3-4 months

Language Requirement: Fluent English required ( U.S.-based company)


Summary

We’re looking for an experienced QA Engineer who ramps up quickly on complex business domains and turns that understanding into clear, risk-based test strategies. You’ll combine strong manual testing skills with proven test case design and automation in .NET (C#) to raise the bar on quality across web, API, and data flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and DevOps to deliver reliable, testable, and observable software continuously.


What You’ll Do

  • Translate business processes into tests: Rapidly learn product/domain concepts and map endtoend workflows into highvalue test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test suites: Build and maintain comprehensive manual and automated tests (UI, API, integration, regression, smoke, and exploratory).
  • Build .NET automation: Develop and maintain C# test automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright , Selenium WebDriver , SpecFlow BDD , NUnit/xUnit/MSTest ) aligned to SOLID and POM principles.
  • Enable CI/CD quality gates: Integrate automated tests into pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps , GitHub Actions ) with parallel runs, test reporting, and flaky-test management.
  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work with Product Owners to refine acceptance criteria, with Developers to shift-left quality, and with business users to validate in staging/preproduction environments and in production once deployed.
  • Own defect lifecycle: Identify, document, prioritize, and drive resolution of defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, screenshots, and impact.
  • Data & API validation: Test APIs, validate payloads and contracts (e.g., via Swagger/OpenAPI ), and verify database outcomes (SQL Server ).
  • Non-functional checks: Contribute to performance baselines (e.g., k6 , JMeter ), and security test coordination.
  • Test strategy & traceability: Maintain risk-based test plans, coverage maps, and traceability to requirements/ACs.
  • Mentor & improve: Share best practices, pair on tests, and improve standards for reliability, maintainability, and observability of tests.


Must Have Qualifications

  • Software quality assurance experience, including extensive manual testing and test case design.
  • Proficiency in building and maintaining automated tests in .NET (C#) for UI and/or API layers.
  • Strong understanding of .NET/.NET Core , ASP.NET (MVC/Web API) fundamentals, HTTP, and JSON.
  • Hands-on with Selenium and/or Playwright , plus NUnit/xUnit/MSTest ; experience.
  • Comfortable reading application code, using Visual Studio /Visual Studio Code , debugging tests, and collaborating on testability.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub for source control, boards/issues, and CI/CD pipelines.

title: Staff ML Engineer
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role

We are looking for our first Staff Machine Learning Engineer to establish and lead our machine learning initiatives. This is a critical, foundational role where you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of data science and ML at Niche. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities, designing, building, and deploying machine learning models that directly drive business growth and enhance user experience across our platform.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on practitioner who is passionate about translating business challenges into data-driven solutions. You build, you code, you ship, you measure. You have a proven history of deploying ML models into production environments that have delivered tangible results. You possess the experience and desire to mentor future ML hires and establish best practices as our capabilities grow.


What You Will Do

  • Identify & Prioritize: Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data analytics, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize the most impactful ML opportunities that align with Niche’s strategic goals. Our first area of focus is our Recommendations, which includes matching students with the right schools
  • Design & Build: Lead the end-to-end development of machine learning models – from data collection and feature engineering to algorithm selection, training, tuning, and validation. This is a hands-on coding role
  • Deploy & Integrate: Develop production-grade code and systems to deploy, serve, and monitor ML models at scale, ensuring reliability and performance. Integrate models effectively into Niche’s products and internal systems
  • Measure & Iterate: Define key performance metrics, establish robust monitoring frameworks, analyze model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement through iteration and experimentation
  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche


First Year Plan

During the 1st Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings
  • Deep-dive into Niche’s platform, data architecture, and recommendation systems
  • Align with product and engineering teams on business goals and ML impact areas
  • Begin shaping a roadmap for high-impact ML opportunities

Within 3 Months:

  • Deploy your first machine learning model into production with robustmonitoring and
  • feedback loops
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to define success metrics andintegration
  • strategies
  • Establish early ML development workflows, documentation, andperformance monitoring
  • Contribute production-ready code for feature engineering and modelexperimentation

Within 6 Months:

  • Drive measurable improvements through experimentation and model iteration
  • Introduce scalable MLOps practices to support deployment, retraining, and governance
  • Serve as a mentor and set engineering best practices for a growing ML function

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation


What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved
  • Technical Depth (Hands-On):
  • Expertise in Python and common ML libraries/frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, XGBoost)
  • Deep understanding of core ML concepts (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems, NLP, time series analysis, experimentation, model evaluation)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data processing tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark)
  • Experience with ML deployment patterns and MLOps principles (e.g., model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, feature stores)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is essential
  • Business Acumen: Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into well-defined ML problems, and connect technical work back to strategic objectives. You prioritize work based on potential business impact
  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning


Bonus Points

title: Engenheiro de Dados | Node.js • Scala • Databricks
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Atuação em uma empresa de grande porte do setor financeiro , com presença nacional e internacional , em um ambiente moderno, colaborativo e orientado a dados .

Buscamos um profissional com foco em Engenharia de Dados , que possua background em desenvolvimento backend , especialmente com Node.js, Scala e Databricks , para atuar em projetos desafiadores e de alto impacto tecnológico.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em Scala, preferencialmente e Databricks.
  • Experiência prática em Node.js, com foco em microserviços e APIs REST.
  • Vivência em engenharia de dados, especialmente com stream processing e integração entre sistemas.
  • Conhecimentos em Azure (Data Lake, Databricks, Functions, Containers).
  • Experiência com Kafka, EventHub e Service Bus.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Familiaridade com Docker, Git/GitLab, CI/CD e boas práticas de versionamento.
  • Domínio de DDD, TDD e arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Perfil colaborativo, analítico e foco em resultados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar em projetos de engenharia de dados e integração de grandes volumes de informação.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados em Scala e Databricks
  • Criar e evoluir serviços backend e APIs em Node.js, integrando-os a fluxos de dados e aplicações financeiras.
  • Projetar e otimizar modelos de dados em bancos relacionais e não relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL Server).
  • Implementar processos de ingestão e transformação de dados utilizando Kafka, EventHub e Service Bus.
  • Automatizar e gerenciar pipelines CI/CD, garantindo qualidade e rastreabilidade dos entregáveis.
  • Atuar em ambientes cloud (Azure), configurando recursos e monitorando performance.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares de engenharia, produto e dados para garantir escalabilidade, segurança e performance das soluções.

Proven client-facing experience in a support or project implementation role, preferably in trading or risk management solutions in financial institutions. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a master's in financial engineering, Applied Finance/Statistics/Mathematics, or Computational Finance. title: Engenheiro de dados GCP
description:
Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Dados com sólida experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de dados. Este profissional terá papel fundamental no desenho, desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de integração de dados confiáveis, escaláveis e seguras. O candidato ideal deve ter forte conhecimento em plataformas de nuvem, práticas modernas de engenharia de dados e perfil analítico para garantir o fluxo eficiente de dados na organização.

Responsabilidades Principais

Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines ETL/ELT para ingestão, transformação e entrega de dados estruturados e não estruturados.

Implementar frameworks de ingestão de dados a partir de múltiplas fontes (bancos de dados, APIs, arquivos, streaming etc.).

Garantir qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade dos dados por meio de validação, monitoramento e testes automatizados.

Otimizar fluxos de processamento de dados visando custo e performance.

Colaborar com Cientistas de Dados, Analistas e áreas de negócio para fornecer datasets limpos, confiáveis e bem documentados.

Trabalhar com serviços nativos de nuvem (ex.: BigQuery, Dataproc, Dataflow, Databricks, Snowflake) para implementar arquiteturas escaláveis.

Aplicar boas práticas de CI/CD, versionamento e Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) em pipelines de dados.

Assegurar conformidade com normas de segurança, governança e privacidade (ex.: PII, GDPR, LGPD).

Qualificações Necessárias

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência comprovada em engenharia de dados, com foco em construção de pipelines.

Domínio em SQL, Python e Spark.

Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Google Cloud Platform, AWS ou Azure).

Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados, data warehouse e arquiteturas lake/lakehouse.

Vivência com ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Cloud Composer, Prefect, Dagster).

Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps (Git, pipelines CI/CD, Terraform ou similares).

Diferenciais Desejáveis

Experiência com streaming em tempo real (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis).

Conhecimentos em containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

Vivência com pipelines de machine learning e MLOps.

Experiência com catálogos de dados, metadata management e ferramentas de governança.

Competências Comportamentais

Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.

Capacidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara a públicos não técnicos.

Trabalho em equipe, postura proativa e colaborativa.

Inglês fluente (escrito e falado);

espanhol será considerado um diferencial.

title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.


Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs .
  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!


Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.


We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.


Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure .
  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin .
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices .
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub ).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).



Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.


Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

We are looking for an experienced SAP QM Consultant (Contractor) to support SAP S/4HANA implementation and enhancement projects for clients in the pharmaceutical sector .

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is an advantage).
  • Availability to work remotely or hybrid within Brazil under a contractor model (PJ or freelance) .

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Applications open worldwide)

Compensation: $20,000 – 40,000 / year (based on experience and scope of ownership)

Skills: Semantic Search, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, GenAI Frameworks, React Agents, Graph Agents, Document Parsing, Python, Scalable APIs


About AnswerThis


AnswerThis is an AI-powered research platform built to eliminate the most time-consuming part of academic research: the literature review. We serve researchers globally, from PhD students to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in minutes.

Our system understands how papers connect, ranks relevance, summarizes insights, and maps citations. This removes weeks of manual work. But that is just the beginning. We are building a vertically integrated AI research suite that streamlines every stage of academic discovery.

If you want to design algorithms that directly accelerate science in medicine, AI, climate, and more, this is the place to do it.


The Role


We are hiring an AI Engineer to lead the development of the core intelligence behind AnswerThis. This role requires deep expertise in information retrieval, scalable backend systems, and generative AI.

You will:

  • Build and optimize semantic search pipelines, graph-based retrieval, and agentic systems.
  • Design and deploy scalable APIs and services capable of serving hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Architect, implement, and productionize vector databases and embedding-based retrieval systems.
  • Work on GenAI integrations including react agents, graph agents, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration.
  • Set up full-stack search engines from scratch that can handle real-world academic workloads.
  • Contribute directly to the infrastructure that makes cutting-edge science more efficient.


This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will move fast, experiment, and ship production systems that impact thousands of researchers worldwide.


Requirements


  • Strong background in semantic search, vector databases, LLM frameworks, agent-based systems, and document retrieval.
  • Skilled in Python for backend development with the ability to build scalable APIs and services.
  • Past experience deploying systems at scale, including search engines, retrieval pipelines, or embedding models.
  • Ability to design infrastructure that serves hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Experience setting up and hosting APIs with public access while balancing speed, cost, and reliability.
  • A research-driven and pragmatic mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes.


Compensation


$20,000 – 40,000 / year depending on experience, expertise, and scope of ownership. This is a full-time role with significant responsibility and long-term upside.


How to Apply


Send the following to

Subject: AI Engineer Application

Include:

  • Your resume.
  • Details of past projects, especially production-level work with search, retrieval, or GenAI pipelines.
  • A short note on why you want to design algorithms at AnswerThis.


Applications without these will not be considered.

Let us build the future of research together.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
  • Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
  • Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
  • Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
  • Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
  • Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.
  • Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. Atentar aos prazos de vencimento de licenças e documentos.



Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Superior completo em Arquitetura, hotelaria ou turismo;
  • Domínio dos softwares AutoCAD e SketchUp;
  • Pacote Office avançado;
  • Power BI será um diferencial;
  • Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas à gestão da qualidade e atendimento em shopping centers ou em setores similares;
  • Conhecimento de regulamentações e normas de segurança e qualidade.


Local de Trabalho: Boulevard Shopping Feira de Santana

Escala: Trabalha 5 dias e folga 2

- O que você deve ter?

* Experiência prática com bibliotecas de gerenciamento de estado em apps móveis, especialmente Redux.

description:
Job Title: Business Development Manager – Sustainability

Location: Brazil- Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role

BSI is seeking an experienced and strategic Business Development Manager (BDM), Sustainability to maintain and grow relationships with large, strategically important clients. You will coordinate BSI’s global efforts to deliver assurance solutions focused on sustainability, greenhouse gas (GHG) verification, reduction, and neutrality.

In this role, you will lead account planning, achieve sales targets by expanding existing accounts and securing new business, and provide thought leadership within the sustainability space. You will also support sales initiatives across the Americas and actively engage in industry events.


In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Achieve assigned sales targets and drive profitable revenue growth.
  • Develop and manage relationships with strategic accounts and senior business leaders.
  • Retain existing accounts through ongoing engagement and partnership with operational teams.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities to expand BSI’s sustainability client base.
  • Negotiate contracts and close deals, integrating requirements into operational delivery.
  • Support other sales professionals in selling sustainability and GHG audit services.
  • Collaborate with global marketing, product development, and sales teams on priorities and initiatives.
  • Participate in industry associations, conferences, and events to provide thought leadership.
  • Conduct account health checks, review pricing annually, and facilitate issue resolution.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM data to support business planning and customer service.
  • Analyze market conditions, competitors, and customer insights to enhance sales performance.


To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, quimical engineer or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • At least 5 years of experience in solutions sales and business development.
  • Experience selling assessment or audit solutions within professional services.
  • Proven ability to engage senior-level management and manage multinational client relationships.

Aqui, você vai trabalhar com um time apaixonado por desafios, que respira tecnologia no dia a dia e é referência no mercado por inovação e expertise. Tudo isso de forma 100% remota, em home office. Quer saber como funciona uma Registradora de Recebíveis? Acesse nosso site.

title: EDI Open Text (Inglês Avançado)
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Salesforce Lead to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will lead and own the full software development life cycle (SDLC) of Salesforce projects, providing technical leadership and ensuring successful delivery of high-quality solutions. This role requires collaboration with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.


Responsibilities:

Lead and own the full software development life cycle (SDLC) of Salesforce projects, including requirement analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and support.

Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

Design and implement customized solutions on the Salesforce platform using Apex, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Visualforce, SOAP/Rest APIs, and declarative tools.

Focus on Salesforce Vlocity development with an emphasis on Enterprise Product Catalog (EPC)/CPQ, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), OmniScripts, DataRaptors, and Integration Procedures (IPs).

Manage offshore team and support existing Salesforce applications, including troubleshooting, bug fixing, and performance tuning.

Provide technical leadership to junior developers, including planning, assigning, and reviewing their tasks, to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.

Collaborate with business stakeholders to prioritize tickets based on urgency, impact, and business value.

Estimate effort and timelines for user stories and tasks to support effective sprint planning.

Plan and create sprints, ensuring a balanced workload and alignment with project timelines and objectives.

Assign tasks to team members based on skillsets, availability, and delivery priorities.

Conduct daily stand-up meetings to track progress, gather updates, and identify and resolve blockers.

Coordinate cross-functionally to ensure timely resolution of dependencies and issues impacting delivery.

Liaise with the testing team to review test scenarios and support test planning activities.

Coordinate with business users for UAT (User Acceptance Testing), ensuring validation of functionality and obtaining final sign-off.

Conduct detailed code reviews and handle deployments using GitHub and Jenkins.

Hold accountability for the successful delivery of assigned Salesforce solutions, meeting both technical and business expectations.

Stay updated with Salesforce platform enhancements and proactively manage critical release updates.


Qualifications:

Proven experience leading Salesforce projects through the full SDLC.

Expertise in Apex, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Visualforce, SOAP/REST APIs, and Salesforce declarative tools.

Strong background in Salesforce Vlocity development, particularly with EPC/CPQ, CLM, OmniScripts, DataRaptors, and IPs.

Experience managing offshore teams and supporting existing Salesforce applications.

Ability to provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers.

Proficient in performing code reviews and handling deployments using GitHub and Jenkins.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Proactive approach to stay informed about platform enhancements and release updates.

Experience in coordinating with business stakeholders to prioritize work, plan sprints, and ensure smooth project delivery.

title: Analista de Suporte de Redes Sociais
description:
Missão do Cargo:

Gerenciar e monitorar o comportamento dos usuários nas redes sociais, identificando tendências, interagindo de forma ativa e estratégica para prevenir situações negativas e promover melhorias na experiência do cliente. Compartilhar insights relevantes com as áreas internas, contribuindo para o aprimoramento contínuo da imagem da marca e do relacionamento com o público.

Atuamos no segmento de apostas esportivas e cassino online , o que exige atenção constante ao comportamento do mercado, comunicação assertiva e gestão cuidadosa da reputação digital, garantindo uma experiência positiva e responsável aos nossos usuários.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Monitorar diariamente as redes sociais da empresa, identificando menções, comentários e tendências de comportamento dos usuários.
  • Interagir com os usuários de forma rápida, cordial e eficaz, esclarecendo dúvidas e solucionando demandas simples.
  • Mapear situações de risco, crises ou reclamações que possam impactar a reputação da marca e comunicar às áreas responsáveis.
  • Elaborar relatórios periódicos com análises de comportamento, volume de interações e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Auxiliar na implementação de ações que promovam o engajamento positivo e o fortalecimento da imagem da marca.


Requisitos e Habilidades:

  • Experiência com gestão e suporte em redes sociais.
  • Conhecimento das principais plataformas (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, TikTok, etc.) e suas ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e capacidade de resposta rápida e empática.
  • Perfil analítico para interpretar dados e gerar insights.
  • Organização e habilidade para gerenciar múltiplas demandas simultaneamente.
  • Conhecimento básico sobre o mercado de apostas online é um diferencial.


Indicadores de Performance (KPIs):

  • Tempo médio de resposta às interações nas redes sociais.
  • Volume e qualidade das interações realizadas.
  • Índice de satisfação do usuário nas redes sociais.
  • Número de situações críticas identificadas e mitigadas.
  • Engajamento e crescimento das redes sociais (curtidas, compartilhamentos, comentários positivos).

  • Auxílio home office
  • Gympass

title: .Net Developer - Pleno

  • Database Management: Skill in working with relational databases like SQL Server and Postgres, including design and query optimization.
  • Containerization and Orchestration: Knowledge of Docker for containerization and Kubernetes for application orchestration.
  • Leadership and Mentoring: Ability to provide technical leadership and mentor junior developers, fostering team growth.

title: Marketing Operations Analyst
description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a highly organized, data-driven, and creative Marketing Operations Analyst to own the planning, execution, and optimization of multi-channel marketing initiatives of Bybit in Brazil. You will play a key role in scaling marketing operations, improving efficiency, and delivering measurable results across campaigns and regions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Campaign Management: Plan, design, set up, and execute multi-channel marketing campaigns from concept to delivery.
  • Process Optimization: Continuously iterate, improve, and build scalable marketing workflows and operational frameworks.
  • Channel Ownership: Manage and optimize performance across multiple channels — Email Marketing, Push Notifications, Landing Pages, Social Media, Affiliates, SEO, Paid Ads, and more.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate closely with designers, translators, copywriters, operators, and developers to ensure timely and high-quality campaign delivery.
  • Planning & Budgeting: Lead quarterly planning for regional deliverables and team budgets; ensure efficient budget control and ROI optimization.
  • Testing & Optimization: Coordinate and analyze A/B tests across strategies, cohorts, and channels to enhance conversion rates and campaign effectiveness.
  • Data & Insights: Deliver actionable insights and analyses focused on acquisition, activation, and retention strategies.
  • Localization Quality: Oversee and improve translation quality for localized content (e.g., pt-BR) across app, website, and marketing assets.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Growth, Digital Marketing, or related roles.
  • Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in marketing analytics tools (e.g., Excel, Google Analytics, Looker Studio, Tableau.)
  • Hands-on experience managing multi-channel marketing campaigns.
  • Excellent communication skills both in english and Brazilian Portuguese
  • Project management skills.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing, automation platforms, and performance measurement.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities.
  • Experience in crypto and/or fintechs is a plus
  • Bonus: Experience managing marketing efforts across multiple regions.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Salesforce
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). title: Técnico de enfermagem
description:
VEJA O ANÚNCIO ATÉ O FINAL. EVITAMOS CURIOSOS.

Empresa contrata colaborador com formação em Técnico de Enfermagem com experiência em clínica médica em Salvador.


Horário de Trabalho: Segunda 13:00 às 18:00 (sem intervalo).

Terça a Quinta-feira (08:00 às 18:00) (1h de almoço).

Sexta-feira: 08:00 às 17:00 (1h de almoço).

Salário Base: R$ 3.022,72 (CLT, 40 horas semanais)

Benefícios Fixos: Vale-transporte: Fornecido conforme legislação, com desconto de até 6% do salário base, se aplicável.

Adicional de Insalubridade: 20% sobre o salário mínimo vigente.


Temos um desafio para pessoas que:

Gostam de relacionar com pessoas, são comunicativas e proativas.

A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.

Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.

Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.

Se comprometem com os resultados.


Oque você irá fazer?

Assistência ao Paciente:

  • Realizar acolhimento e atendimento humanizado aos pacientes.
  • Executar procedimentos de enfermagem sob supervisão, como preparo e administração de medicamentos por vias subcutânea, intramuscular e intravenosa, garantindo o correto manuseio e técnica conforme prescrição médica.
  • Auxiliar no preparo dos pacientes para exames, consultas e procedimentos médicos.
  • Monitorar os pacientes durante e após os procedimentos para identificar possíveis reações adversas comunicando ao médico assistente;

Exames e Triagem:

  • Realizar triagem inicial, coletando dados e histórico do paciente, exames básicos, como aferição de pressão arterial, glicemia capilar, bioimpedância e coleta de sangue.
  • Registrar sinais vitais e informações relevantes sobre o paciente no prontuário eletrônico.

Organização e Controle:

  • Manter o controle de insumos e medicamentos, garantindo reposição e armazenamento correto.
  • Organizar e higienizar os materiais e equipamentos utilizados nos procedimentos.

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.

  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

  • Gympass

  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor Java Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 53201


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


O que você deve ter?


- Domínio em Java (8+) e ecossistema Spring (Boot, Data, Security, Cloud, Batch, MVC);

- Conhecimento em Design Patterns e princípios SOLID;

- Experiência com arquitetura em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP), incluindo uso de serviços como ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3 ou CloudWatch;

- Vivência com mensageria e filas (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, SNS) para integração entre sistemas e processamento assíncrono;

- Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis);

- Prática em CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) e versionamento com Git;

- Experiência com conteinerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, integração e performance);

- Desejável: conhecimento em NodeJS para integrações leves, APIs RESTful e documentação com Swagger/OpenAPI;

- Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk) será um diferencial;


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Talent Development Partner
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at


Position Overview

We are seeking a highly creative and hands-on Senior Talent Development Partner to support the establishment of our newly formed Talent Development function. In this role, you will embrace a customer-centric, pragmatic approach, laser-focused on delivering maximum impact through the simplest, highest-quality solutions.

We are here for the growth and development of our customers, Turing Team Members. You will partner closely with leaders to understand their desired development outcomes, time constraints, and needs. Leveraging this knowledge, you will craft relevant, engaging learning content that drives measurable business results for our internal customers. You will seek out simple yet impactful solutions, recognizing that the most compelling learning experiences are often the most practical.


Responsibilities

  • Deeply collaborate with Turing leaders to translate team development needs into compelling, practical learning experiences driving measurable growth.
  • Design and develop engaging, multimedia-rich asynchronous learning content using tools like Articulate, tailoring for diverse styles through simple, high-impact solutions.
  • Serve as the go-to operational owner for the LMS system, curating and maintaining a dynamic, streamlined training catalog. Continuously refine materials for relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with customer needs.
  • Embody an agile, customer-obsessed mindset, rapidly producing high-quality, iterative content elevated by feedback and data.
  • Be a key driving force behind the development, engagement, and iterations of Sales and Engineering bootcamp programs.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience driving the development of L&D initiatives in a high-growth startup or late-stage tech environment.
  • Experienced leveraging LMS systems like Docebo, e-learning platforms, intranet solutions, and instructional design tools like Articulate to deliver impactful learning experiences.
  • Exceptional collaboration and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer-centric approach to building relationships and delivering outstanding service to stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to analyse training metrics, evaluate impact, and translate findings into actionable recommendations to enhance learning solutions.
  • Demonstrated skill in translating business objectives into innovative, engaging, and practical learning solutions that drive measurable results.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the centre of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favour action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant

Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.

title: VMware Administrator
description:
VMware Engineer (Remote – EST Hours)

Schedule: 40h/week • On-call rotation required

Contract: Contractor


About the Role

Our client is looking for an experienced VMware Engineer to join our infrastructure team, supporting large-scale virtualized environments and ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability across global data centers.

The ideal professional has strong hands-on experience with vSAN , VMware cluster management, upgrades, and networking at the hypervisor level.


Key Responsibilities

Virtualization & Infrastructure Management

  • Administer and support VMware ESXi and vCenter environments (versions 7 and 8; migration to 9 planned).
  • Manage VMware clusters, VMware Distributed Switches (VDS), and ESXi host configurations.
  • Perform vCenter and ESXi upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure optimal configuration, performance, and availability of virtual infrastructure.

vSAN (Mandatory)

  • Manage and support VMware vSAN environments (minimum 2 years of hands-on experience).
  • Monitor vSAN health, performance, and storage capacity.
  • Troubleshoot vSAN-related storage, performance, and node issues.

Networking & System Administration

  • Configure and troubleshoot VLANs, trunks, port groups, and VM networking issues.
  • Understand network configuration at the hypervisor level and how to troubleshoot VM connectivity.
  • Integrate and manage Active Directory within vCenter environments.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience with VMware vSAN (must-have).
  • 5+ years of experience administering VMware environments (versions 7 and 8).
  • Hands-on expertise in:
  • VMware Cluster & VDS Management
  • vSAN configuration and maintenance
  • ESXi host upgrades and patching
  • vCenter lifecycle management
  • Understanding of VLANs, trunks, and virtual networking.
  • Basic knowledge of Active Directory integration in vCenter.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills in complex virtualized environments.


Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting large enterprise VMware environments.
  • Familiarity with automation or scripting tools (PowerCLI, Python).
  • Knowledge of backup/restore strategies in virtual infrastructures.


Work Environment

  • Remote role aligned to EST business hours (8:30 AM–5:30 PM) .
  • Includes on-call rotation for critical support needs.
