title: Senior Data Administrator
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior Data Administrator who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid (with the possibility of 100% remote) , in the city of Londrina.


MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES *

Main Responsibilities

● Data Modeling: Design, develop, and maintain relational and multidimensional data models to meet the requirements of transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP/Data Warehouse) systems.


● Metadata Management: Manage the data catalog, defining business concepts, maintaining data lineage, and ensuring that metadata is clear and accessible.


● Data Quality: Implement and monitor data quality rules, identify anomalies, and collaborate with business and development teams to correct inconsistencies.

● Data Governance: Support the creation, curation, and evolution of best practice guides and standards for data modeling and integration, ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulations such as the LGPD (Brazilian General Data Protection Law).

● Implementation and Curation: Create and curate physical data models in databases, ensuring that the implementation is aligned with the logical design.

● Technical Collaboration: Act as a point of reference for development, BI, and data science teams, offering support and expertise on issues related to data structure and access.


Nice to Have:

● Experience with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) applied to data projects (DataOps).

● Knowledge of other data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation). ● Experience in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), especially with database and data lake services.

● Advanced or fluent English for collaboration with global teams.

● Previous experience in the company's sector (e.g., finance, retail, industry).


JOB REQUIREMENTS


MINIMUM REQUIREMENT FOR THE POSITION * DESIRABLE

Education Experience

Minimum Education and Experience

● Education: Completed and proven higher education in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related fields. Short courses or predominantly online courses will not be considered as primary education.

● Experience: Minimum of 6 years of market experience, working directly with data modeling, administration, and governance.

● Professional Stability: Average of 2 years of tenure in previous jobs, according to resume history. Certifications (Desirable)

● At least one active certification, such as:

○ DAMA Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) - Associate or Practitioner level.

○ Certification in specific tools (e.g., Informatica, Oracle).


Technical Skills

Technical Skills (Hard Skills)

● Proficiency in relational (3NF) and dimensional (Star Schema, Snowflake) data modeling.

● Proven experience with data modeling tools, preferably Oracle SQL Developer Data Modeler.

● Solid knowledge of Data Governance tools for Catalog, Lineage, and Quality, preferably the Informatica suite (IDMC/Axon/EDC).

● In-depth knowledge of the General Data Protection Law (LGPD) and its application in data architectures.

● Proficiency in SQL for data analysis, manipulation, and validation.


● Knowledge of Data Warehousing, Data Marts, and Business Intelligence concepts. Behavioral Competencies (Soft Skills)

● Analytical Vision: Ability to analyze complex requirements and translate them into effective data solutions.

● Assertive Communication: Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences (technical and business).

● Organization and Focus: Discipline to manage multiple projects and priorities autonomously.

title: Senior Market Research Manager
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights e consultoria, que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance!


Objetivo do cargo

Desenvolver novos negócios junto a clientes atuais e potenciais, garantindo um relacionamento estratégico com as contas sob sua responsabilidade. Liderar o time na entrega de um serviço de alta qualidade, gerando valor para o cliente e contribuindo para o crescimento sustentável da operação, com foco em fidelização e desenvolvimento contínuo.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e expandir o portfólio de serviços oferecidos aos clientes atuais.
  • Atuar de forma estratégica no atendimento das contas, garantindo excelência na entrega e na comunicação.
  • Cumprir as metas de vendas estabelecidas, identificando e aproveitando oportunidades de crescimento incremental.
  • Conhecer a fundo o negócio dos clientes para propor soluções alinhadas às suas necessidades.
  • Aumentar os níveis de satisfação dos clientes por meio de um serviço consultivo e personalizado.
  • Construir e manter relacionamento próximo com stakeholders chave dos clientes, influenciando decisões estratégicas.
  • Planejar e executar ações para atingir os objetivos de receita definidos anualmente.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar planos de ação, forecasts e orçamento dos clientes.
  • Liderar, desenvolver e motivar a equipe de atendimento ao cliente, promovendo um ambiente saudável e colaborativo.
  • Participar de projetos internos estratégicos, atuando como ponto focal entre áreas.
  • Contribuir com a criação e melhoria de metodologias e ferramentas de análise.
  • Garantir treinamentos e desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe, com feedbacks periódicos.


Requisitos

  • Graduação em Administração, Marketing, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Especialização ou MBA em Marketing ou Administração é um diferencial.
  • Experiência sólida em pesquisa de mercado, consultoria ou marketing.
  • Experiência prévia liderando equipes ou unidades de negócio.
  • Forte vivência em atendimento a clientes e negociação de alto nível.
  • Conhecimento da metodologia de painéis de consumo é desejável.
  • Perfil analítico, estratégico e com foco em resultados.
  • Excelentes habilidades interpessoais, de liderança e comunicação.
  • Inglês avançado
  • Espanhol (desejável)


O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Horário Flexível;
  • Home-office;
  • Programa Qualidade de Vida: Totalpass, participação em corridas, vacinação contra gripe, palestras sobre temas relevantes e muito mais;
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna – a Worldpanel valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua.

title: Affiliate Administrator – LATAM (Remote)
description:
Ready to take your affiliate marketing expertise to the next level? Join GrowthAssistant as an Affiliate Administrator and play a pivotal role in leading the entire affiliate marketing process for a top U.S.-based agency. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a renowned brand while driving performance, managing partner communications, and ensuring campaigns run smoothly from start to finish.


You’ll be at the heart of strategic marketing efforts with a focus on accuracy, trend analysis, and client success—all while enjoying the flexibility of a remote setup, competitive pay, and great benefits.


Compensation & Perks

  • Salary Range: $6.00 – $7.50/hour (Final offer based on skills and experience matched to role requirements)
  • 100% permanent work-from-home
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) for Vacation and U.S. Holidays
  • $300 Referral Bonus for every successful candidate you refer
  • Performance-Based Bonuses
  • Year-End Bonus (client-initiated)
  • Perfect Attendance Bonus (for LATAM candidates)


What You’ll Do

  • Performance Reporting: Download and prepare performance reports using proprietary analytics tools for End of Week (EOW), End of Month (EOM), and End of Year (EOY) deliverables
  • Compliance Monitoring: Conduct weekly checks of affiliate sites for valid/invalid promotion codes and send templated emails to partners in violation
  • Outreach for Corrections: Send outbound templated emails to partners requesting corrections for compliance violations
  • BrandVerity Checks: Perform semi-weekly checks to monitor for trademark infringements and follow up with violators
  • KPI Oversight: Track daily client KPIs, compare results to defined guardrails, and flag discrepancies to the Account Manager
  • Monthly Recaps: Process monthly voids/edits and compile comprehensive recaps for internal review
  • Publisher Outreach: Assist in building publisher lists by researching contacts for provided publisher lists


What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in affiliate marketing
  • Familiarity with Commission Junction or similar affiliate tools, and BrandVerity or similar platforms
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Intermediate proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and MS Office
  • Experience managing multiple clients or brands (a plus)
  • Highly organized, proactive, resourceful, and detail-oriented
  • Ability to work in any U.S. timezone or a night shift schedule in the Philippines


Why You’ll Love Working Here

At GrowthAssistant, you’ll collaborate with a diverse, talented team, sharpen your skills with global clients, and make an impact in affiliate marketing. We value your growth and recognize your contributions every step of the way.


Apply today and take the next step in your career with GrowthAssistant!

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência em SAP: 8 a 10 anos de experiência em SAP SD , com foco em localização brasileira .
  • Conhecimento de localização: Profundo conhecimento da localização SAP para o Brasil, incluindo transformação eletrônica e requisitos de e-documents .
  • Conhecimento de sistemas: Experiência em projetos de implementação e implantação SAP ECC é um diferencial.

  • Idioma: Fluência em português e inglês é essencial.

title: Senior Front-end Engineer (Browser Extension)
description:
We are looking for a remote Senior Front-end Engineer (Browser Extension) to develop and publish Chrome extensions for our U.S. client. The duration of this project will last 3-6 months with the opportunity to extend into a full-time position.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively implement formal security and privacy programs, measure the effectiveness of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality Chrome extensions that meet product and user requirements
  • Integrate Chrome Extension APIs to create seamless user experiences and efficient browser functionality
  • Collaborate with designers and back-end developers to ensure smooth data flow and consistent UI/UX
  • Debug, test, and optimize extensions for performance, compatibility, and scalability
  • Manage the full lifecycle of Chrome extensions, including publishing, version control, and updates in the Chrome Web Store
  • Stay current with evolving Chrome APIs and web development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of proven experience developing and publishing Chrome extensions
  • Solid understanding of Chrome Extension architecture and APIs (e.g., Manifest v3, background scripts, content scripts, messaging, and permissions)
  • Experience building interactive front-end components with .js
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Ability to write clean, modular, and maintainable code
  • Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) and modern web development workflows
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, or related field
  • Experience with Node.js


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Data Migration Specialist - Brazil
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Data Migration Specialist - Brazil , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract hybrid or remote.


In this role you will:

The Data Migration Specialist is responsible for transitioning and transforming data from legacy systems to new platforms. The specialist will ensure data integrity, security, and accessibility throughout the migration process, thus supporting the organization's strategic initiatives and operational efficiency. The professional will proactively identify and mitigate risks, ensuring a smooth and successful transition with minimal disruption to business operations.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Data Migration and Transformation: Design and implement data migration processes. Develop scripts, ETL processes ( Extract, Transform, Load) and tools for data migration, adapted to the specific requirements of the project. Utilize SQL, data mapping, and transformation techniques to optimize efficiency.
  • Data Integrity and Quality: Ensure data integrity and validation during the migration process. Perform regular audits and validation checks to verify the accuracy and completeness of the migrated data. Oversee user acceptance testing (UAT) and adjust the migration approach as needed.
  • Project and Risk Management: Plan and manage data migration projects, including resource allocation and schedule management. Identify and mitigate the risks associated with data migration, developing proactive strategies to address potential challenges.
  • Compliance and Governance: Ensuring that data migration processes comply with industry standards and regulations. Adhere to organizational policies and procedures.
  • Documentation and Communication: Generate regular progress reports for stakeholders. Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all data migration activities, ensuring transparency, accountability, and knowledge sharing.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 8 to 10 years of experience. At least 5 years of experience in data migration and management.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Technical Tools and Skills:
  • Proficiency in SQL and data migration tools like Talend, Informatica .
  • Experience with database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle ) to manage and migrate data.
  • Proven knowledge and experience in the design and implementation of ETL processes.
  • Advanced English and/or French.

Soft Skills:

  • Problem Solving: Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Communication: Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail.

title: Marketing Cloud Senior Developer - Salesforce
description:
Marketing Cloud Senior Developer - Salesforce


Visão Geral da Posição

O Desenvolvedor Sênior de Marketing Cloud será responsável por desenvolver soluções dentro da plataforma Salesforce Marketing Cloud para apoiar funções críticas de negócio e atender aos requisitos de projetos.

Essa função exige uma combinação sólida de proficiência técnica, pensamento criativo e atenção aos detalhes . O profissional colaborará de perto com equipes de marketing, design, dados e gestão de campanhas para entregar experiências digitais impactantes que envolvam milhões de clientes.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implantar soluções complexas de automação de marketing utilizando o Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Cloud Pages e Mobile Studio).
  • Implementar personalização e segmentação baseadas em dados , utilizando Data Extensions, consultas SQL e lógica AMPscript .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar Cloud Pages, formulários e landing pages integradas aos dados e APIs do Marketing Cloud.
  • Criar e manter jornadas e automações para campanhas gatilhadas, comportamentais e de ciclo de vida .
  • Projetar e implementar fluxos de integração de dados entre o SFMC e outros sistemas (Sales/Service Cloud, CDP ou fontes de dados externas).
  • Criar e gerenciar Data Extensions, atividades de consulta e processos de automação para garantir fluxo de dados eficiente.
  • Trabalhar com APIs (REST/SOAP) e Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) para integrações avançadas e conteúdo dinâmico.
  • Seguir padrões de codificação e melhores práticas dentro do ecossistema Marketing Cloud.
  • Atuar como especialista técnico (SME) em todos os trabalhos de desenvolvimento relacionados ao SFMC.
  • Colaborar com arquitetos e equipes de operações de marketing para impulsionar melhorias na plataforma e implementar novas funcionalidades.
  • Trabalhar com as equipes de marketing e design para transformar conceitos criativos em soluções tecnicamente viáveis.
  • Revisar códigos e orientar desenvolvedores juniores , garantindo escalabilidade, performance e manutenibilidade.
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas técnicos , otimizando para velocidade, confiabilidade e engajamento.
  • Supervisionar testes de renderização e entregabilidade utilizando ferramentas como o Litmus .
  • Manter altos padrões de privacidade de dados, conformidade (CAN-SPAM, GDPR) e segurança.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de analytics para estabelecer rastreamento de performance, relatórios e insights a partir dos dados do SFMC.
  • Avaliar continuamente novos recursos do SFMC, atualizações e melhores práticas do mercado para aprimorar as capacidades da plataforma.
  • Explorar e implementar recursos de IA, personalização e inteligência preditiva dentro do Marketing Cloud.


Habilidades e Experiência:

  • Graduação em TI, Ciência da Computação ou área equivalente , com 7 a 10 anos de experiência em TI e mínimo de 5 anos com Salesforce Marketing Cloud .
  • Conhecimento aprofundado da plataforma Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) e compreensão dos conceitos essenciais de e-mail marketing e automação .
  • Experiência com Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automations, SQL, Content Builder e criação de audiências para Advertising Studio .
  • Proficiência em HTML, CSS, JavaScript e AMPscript para desenvolvimento de e-mails.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e experiência em testes e depuração de e-mails usando o Litmus .
  • Compreensão das melhores práticas da Salesforce para automação de marketing .
  • Capacidade e vontade de trabalhar com alto grau de autonomia e senso de propriedade em uma equipe geograficamente distribuída , composta por outros desenvolvedores e recursos de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Boas habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal .
  • Ingles avançado


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo : Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente : Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores

  • Cultura de Inovação : Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade : Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

title: Senior HRBP LATAM
description:
We're conducting a search for a Strategic Regional Talent Partner with 10+ years of progressive HR experience, an essential and proven focus on the Latin American (LATAM) region, and fluency in Portuguese and English with good verbal communication in Spanish.

This role works very closely with the C level (VP and Director level), influencing the business and translating business objectives into effective people and talent strategies. Will drive and implement global HR initiatives across key Latin American markets and addressing the unique challenges of the region.

This is a strategic and consultancy-focused role, dedicated to high-level partnering.


Key Areas of Accountability & Impact


The Strategic Regional Talent Partner is expected to drive results across three primary domains:


1. Strategic Business Partnership & Consulting


  • Executive Guidance: Serve as the primary HR advisor to senior regional executives, translating complex business objectives into actionable people plans
  • Performance Optimization: Provide expert counsel on maximizing business unit performance
  • Global Integration: Act as the regional conduit, collaborating with global Centers of Expertise (CoE) to ensure global people initiatives are effectively localized and deployed across LATAM markets.


2. Talent Management & Program Execution


  • High-Level Program Support: Directly advise and support senior leaders during critical annual organizational cycles
  • Capability Building: Partner with business leaders to identify and close critical skill gaps
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate the integration of talent programs across the business streams, working with cross-functional HR teams


3. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement


  • Process Enhancement: Champion a continuous improvement mindset, actively soliciting feedback from the leadership population to refine HR processes and knowledge resources.
  • Service Model Efficiency: Effectively triage executive requests, leveraging a deep knowledge of the shared services model
  • Knowledge Leadership: Contribute to the overall organizational knowledge base and foster active knowledge sharing across the global HR community.


Required Experience, Skills, & Qualifications


Experience & Educational Foundation

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with a minimum of 4+ years in a senior HR Business Partnering or strategic advisory role spanning multiple LATAM countries .
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field is highly desired.
  • Context: Proven ability to operate successfully within a complex, matrixed global organization utilizing an HR shared services delivery model.

Critical Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Possesses robust business knowledge (industry trends, competitors, market position)
  • Executive Influence: Exceptional ability to build trust, influence senior leaders (VP/Director), .
  • Bilingual Capability: Fluent English is mandatory. Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly desirable.
  • Agility & Judgment: Demonstrates high levels of resilience, adaptability, and critical thinking to navigate ambiguity, manage high-pressure situations, and exercise sound judgment.
  • Technical Familiarity: Experience with leading HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday ) and service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow ) is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Flexibility: Willingness to accommodate business needs across different time zones (LATAM and North America).

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time AI Software Engineer to join our US client's team. You should have a minimum of 3 to 5+ years of experience developing and delivering commercial software, with a solid background in AI/ML, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and C#/ .NET.

In this role, you will leverage deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This position is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3 to 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, TypeScript, and C#/.NET
  • Agile development experience
  • Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
  • Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
  • Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
  • Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, and more)
  • Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
  • Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
  • Previous exposure to the Microsoft Orleans distributed systems framework
  • Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
  • Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
  • Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

title: Coordenador de Mídia
description:
Oportunidade Coordenador de Mídia | Brasil


A Pipolhub , uma AI-Media Agency e AdTech Solutions especializada em performance, presente em 7 das principais indústrias da América Latina , está em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) de Operações para representar nossa operação no Brasil com excelência, dedicação exclusiva e visão estratégica.


Modelo de Contrato : PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

Local de Trabalho : Remoto

Reporta a : Liderança Brasil e Matriz Argentina


Com 4 escritórios (Buenos Aires, México, São Paulo e Miami) e mais de 100 profissionais , a Pipolhub combina expertise em mídia com tecnologia proprietária para potencializar resultados de seus clientes.


Nosso diferencial :


WE EMPOWER YOUR BUSINESS with comprehensive strategies, real-time data analysis and AI technology to optimise your campaigns.


Nossas duas unidades de negócio :


  • Media Agency : especializada em campanhas de comunicação para a indústria de apostas e gaming online na América Latina.
  • AdTech (MIA) : nossa solução SaaS que realiza auditoria e otimização de planos de mídia em tempo real, utilizando Big Data, cloud e inteligência artificial.


Nossa expertise :


  • Performance Media Strategy : estratégias de mídia baseadas em performance e dados em tempo real.
  • Business Consulting : alinhamento entre objetivos comerciais e estratégias de mídia para crescimento sustentável.
  • ROI Media Optimization : maximização de retorno por meio de tecnologia, analytics e otimizações contínuas.


Propósito da Função:


O(a) coordenador(a) será responsável por garantir agilidade, organização e excelência em toda a operação brasileira, atuando em interface com clientes, veículos, plataformas e a equipe internacional.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Planejamento de Mídia

  • Apoiar na elaboração de estratégias com base em dados de mercado e institutos de pesquisa.
  • Criar planos de mídia claros, organizados e consistentes.

Negociação com Veículos e Plataformas

  • Apoiar negociações com publishers, emissoras e plataformas.
  • Buscar constantemente novas oportunidades e atualizações do mercado.

Implementação de Campanhas

  • Organizar e consolidar especificações técnicas.
  • Gerenciar fluxo entre cliente, mídia e criação.
  • Garantir auditoria de veiculação e mensuração de KPIs.

Otimização de Performance

  • Monitorar KPIs e propor ajustes ágeis.
  • Identificar oportunidades de escala e otimizar rotas de execução.

Relatórios e Pós-venda

  • Elaborar relatórios semanais de desempenho.
  • Produzir materiais de comprovação de entrega e performance.

Atividades Complementares

  • Apoiar demandas internas da operação.
  • Atuar como ponte entre Brasil e Argentina, assegurando excelência operacional.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência em mídia e operações de agência.
  • Forte capacidade de organização e agilidade.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Disponibilidade exclusiva e comprometimento com a operação.
  • Perfil analítico, com foco em eficiência e resultados.
  • Inglês fluente
  • Espanhol será um diferencial



Pronto para alavancar sua carreira e fazer parte de uma equipe que está revolucionando o mercado de mídia com tecnologia e dados?


Junte-se à Pipolhub e venha construir o futuro da mídia conosco!

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time AI Software Engineer to join our US client's team. You should have a minimum of 3 to 5+ years of experience developing and delivering commercial software, with a solid background in AI/ML, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and C#/ .NET.

In this role, you will leverage deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This position is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3 to 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, TypeScript, and C#/.NET
  • Agile development experience
  • Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
  • Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
  • Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
  • Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, and more)
  • Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
  • Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
  • Previous exposure to the Microsoft Orleans distributed systems framework
  • Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
  • Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
  • Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:

Nessa posição você irá:

O(A) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior é responsável por desenhar, construir e otimizar os pipelines de dados que servem como base para as iniciativas de Business Intelligence e Ciência de Dados da empresa. Este profissional atuará como uma referência técnica, garantindo que as soluções de dados sejam escaláveis, seguras e alinhadas às necessidades de negócio. Sua missão é transformar dados brutos em insights acionáveis, trabalhando em ambientes de alto volume e criticidade para suportar decisões estratégicas em públicos heterogêneos.


Principais Responsabilidades

● Desenvolver e manter pipelines de ETL/ELT robustos, utilizando ferramentas como Azure Data Factory, Synapse Pipelines e SSIS.

● Modelar dados em formatos relacionais e multidimensionais (Star Schema) para otimizar consultas e análises.

● Atuar como referência técnica para equipes de Ciência de Dados e Análise de Negócio, garantindo o acesso a dados de qualidade.

● Implementar e gerenciar soluções de Big Data em ambientes cloud, principalmente em Microsoft Azure (Data Lake, Synapse Analytics).

● Garantir a governança dos dados, aplicando padrões de desenvolvimento, qualidade e segurança.

● Automatizar processos de carga e replicação de dados, incluindo cenários de real-time.

● Colaborar na implementação de esteiras de DevOps (CI/CD) para projetos de Analytics e IA.


Formação e Experiência Mínima

  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos atuando diretamente com Engenharia de Dados ou Business Intelligence.
  • Estabilidade profissional com média de 2 anos nas últimas experiências registradas no currículo.
  • Formação superior completa e comprovada em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Não serão considerados cursos de curta duração ou predominantemente online.
  • Inglês em nível avançado para leitura técnica e comunicação.


Certificações

  • Obrigatório: Possuir pelo menos uma certificação técnica ativa relacionada à engenharia de dados.
  • Exemplo recomendado: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203).


Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills):

  • Sólida experiência em ambientes de dados heterogêneos, críticos e com alto volume.
  • Domínio de modelagem de dados multidimensional (star schema) e relacional.
  • SQL em nível avançado para consultas complexas e otimização de performance.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de ETL, preferencialmente SSIS, Azure Synapse Pipelines ou Azure Data Factory.
  • Conhecimento em ecossistemas Big Data (ex: Hadoop) e programação em Python para manipulação de dados.
  • Vivência com soluções de BI e visualização, especialmente Power BI.
  • Experiência com a stack de dados da Microsoft Azure: Azure SQL DB, Synapse Analytics (anteriormente SQL DW), Data Lake Store, e noções de Azure Machine Learning


Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva para interagir com áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Perfil proativo e engajado na resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Capacidade de organização, foco e gestão de prioridades.
  • Atitude colaborativa para trabalhar em equipes multidisciplinares.

● Conhecimento em outras plataformas de cloud (AWS, GCP).

● Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

title: High Ticket closer
description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline

  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion

  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach

  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions

  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

    • QUALIFICATIONS

    • 1+ years of commission sales experience

    • Strong

    • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation

    • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable

    • Strong problem-solving skills

    • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.

    • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability

    • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

    • WHAT WE OFFER

    • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses

    • Remote-friendly work environment

    • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development

    • Supportive, high-performing team culture

title: Sap Quality Management Consultant
description:
SAP QM Consultant (Contract) – Pharma Industry / LIMS Integration


Location: Brazil – Remote / Hybrid (depending on project)

Contract Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

Duration: 12 months (extendable)


About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced SAP QM Consultant (Contractor) to support SAP S/4HANA implementation and enhancement projects for clients in the pharmaceutical sector .

The consultant will play a key role in designing and configuring SAP QM processes, ensuring seamless integration with LIMS (Laboratory Information Management Systems) , and maintaining compliance with GxP and pharmaceutical quality standards .

This is an excellent opportunity for independent SAP professionals who enjoy project-based work, flexibility, and the chance to collaborate in a global, regulated environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Configure and support SAP QM processes (inspection lots, results recording, batch management, certificates).
  • Design and manage SAP–LIMS integrations (LabVantage, LabWare, or equivalent).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (PP-PI, MM, WM/EWM) to align manufacturing and quality processes.
  • Ensure full GxP compliance and support validation, testing, and documentation.
  • Participate in template design, rollouts, and process improvements across global sites.
  • Provide training, functional support, and issue resolution during cutover and go-live.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of proven experience as an SAP QM Consultant .
  • Strong background in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.
  • Hands-on LIMS integration experience (e.g., LabVantage, LabWare, etc.).
  • Working knowledge of S/4HANA , IDoc/qRFC/Web Services , and interface technologies .
  • Understanding of GMP/GxP validation and quality control processes.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is an advantage).
  • Availability to work remotely or hybrid within Brazil under a contractor model (PJ or freelance) .

description:

Como Dev Sr, o seu papel estará focado em desenvolvimento de trabalhos de maior complexidade, além de mentorear os desenvolvedores do time com menos experiência para que se tornem mais capacitados.   • Colaborar com o gerente do time para desenvolver novas formas de trabalho ou implementar novas práticas;
  • Colaborar com times externos para entrega de projetos de maior complexidade que podem requerer uma parceria com times globais.
  • Escrever documentos e guias de requisitos funcionais;
  • Otimizar aplicações para a máxima velocidade e escalabilidade;
  • Participar e se manter atualizado com relação aos treinamentos propostos pelo time de Operações, muitas vezes podendo ser o responsável pela aplicação dos treinamentos com o time menos experiente;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tecnologias emergentes;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos na plataforma Veeva para o desenvolvimento e manutenção em IVAs.


Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada como Front-End;
  • Experiência com diversas linguagens de programação: HTML 5 e Web Standards, CSS (com foco em animações e transições), Java Script, SQL, Vue.js, React, Node; - Experiência com Git, Azure, SVN ou sistemas de controle de versão similares; - Experiência com Adobe XD e Photoshop;

  • Certificação Veeva para desenvolvimento de IVAs.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência anterior da agência, particularmente de uma agência de saúde;
  • A experiência anterior como líder de uma equipe de desenvolvimento é uma vantagem.

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


You’ll be working alongside our Lead Desktop Designer day-to-day, while also collaborating regularly with the larger design team, motion graphics team, and user acquisition team to bring ideas to life from wireframes to polished UIs. While the lead drives the vision, you’ll turn concepts into reality with speed, precision, and polish. You’ll also stay responsive to shifting priorities, adapt to quick turnarounds, and always design with developer feasibility in mind. This is not a research- or strategy-heavy role. We’re looking for someone who’s happy to execute, tweak, and finesse. If you love clean pixels, smooth systems, and being the reliable engine behind great product design this is your role.


Key Responsibilities


  • Translate wireframes and rough concepts into crisp, production-ready designs
  • Build and maintain high-quality UI components for browser extensions and desktop apps
  • Collaborate closely with our lead designer and developers to ensure fast, clean handoff
  • Make smart decisions about when to polish vs. when to ship
  • Adapt to shifting priorities and irregular work cadences without missing a beat
  • Keep designs tight, lean, and respectful of developer constraints
  • Bring taste and craft, even to tight-turnaround projects
  • Contribute to a shared design system and maintain consistency across platforms


Who You Are


  • 3+ years of UI/UX experience with a strong emphasis on desktop design
  • A portfolio that shows clean, dev-friendly UI work—bonus for any
  • browser-related experience or browser extension examples
  • Deep proficiency with Figma and an efficient, systemized approach to
  • design
  • Ability to take direction, iterate fast, and not get precious
  • Strong eye for detail and consistency
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and shifting strategies
  • Respect for dev workloads—your work should make their lives easier, not
  • harder
  • Reliable, communicative, and fun to work with under pressure


Nice to Have


  • Experience designing responsive layouts for desktop applications, with
  • consideration for mobile and adaptive views
  • Light working knowledge of HTML/CSS/JS (enough to understand
  • constraints)
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney) for speed and
  • inspiration
  • Familiarity with accessibility and internationalization basics

description:

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.


Human team members use Artisan as their primary working platform, replacing a sprawling stack of sales tools, and have Artisans working alongside them.


We went through Y Combinator (W24) and have raised $35M+ from top investors. We’re at $7M+ ARR, with hundreds of customers including Remote, Quora, and SumUp. We’re currently working on Ava 2.0, pushing the boundaries of what an AI employee can do. And we're hiring.


Your Mission

You’ll design, build, and scale the backend that powers AI employees while following our principles:

  • Velocity is Everything:  keep the 20/80 rule in mind, delay kills growth
  • Think Like a Founder:  ship with quality, have strong opinions, and speak up if you disagree

  • Communication Rules Everything:  be clear and concise, give candid, unsolicited feedback

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth environments, preferably early-stage or Series B.
  • Strong experience building scalable, data-intensive services with modern APIs and robust infrastructure.

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, reliability, performance, and database systems (SQL + NoSQL).

  • Demonstrated track record of ownership - leading parts of systems independently and shipping with impact.

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Tech Lead Mobile (Flutter)

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


You’ll be working alongside our Lead Desktop Designer day-to-day, while also collaborating regularly with the larger design team, motion graphics team, and user acquisition team to bring ideas to life from wireframes to polished UIs. While the lead drives the vision, you’ll turn concepts into reality with speed, precision, and polish. You’ll also stay responsive to shifting priorities, adapt to quick turnarounds, and always design with developer feasibility in mind. This is not a research- or strategy-heavy role. We’re looking for someone who’s happy to execute, tweak, and finesse. If you love clean pixels, smooth systems, and being the reliable engine behind great product design this is your role.


Key Responsibilities


  • Translate wireframes and rough concepts into crisp, production-ready designs
  • Build and maintain high-quality UI components for browser extensions and desktop apps
  • Collaborate closely with our lead designer and developers to ensure fast, clean handoff
  • Make smart decisions about when to polish vs. when to ship
  • Adapt to shifting priorities and irregular work cadences without missing a beat
  • Keep designs tight, lean, and respectful of developer constraints
  • Bring taste and craft, even to tight-turnaround projects
  • Contribute to a shared design system and maintain consistency across platforms


Who You Are


  • 3+ years of UI/UX experience with a strong emphasis on desktop design
  • A portfolio that shows clean, dev-friendly UI work—bonus for any
  • browser-related experience or browser extension examples
  • Deep proficiency with Figma and an efficient, systemized approach to
  • design
  • Ability to take direction, iterate fast, and not get precious
  • Strong eye for detail and consistency
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and shifting strategies
  • Respect for dev workloads—your work should make their lives easier, not
  • harder
  • Reliable, communicative, and fun to work with under pressure


Nice to Have


  • Experience designing responsive layouts for desktop applications, with
  • consideration for mobile and adaptive views
  • Light working knowledge of HTML/CSS/JS (enough to understand
  • constraints)
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney) for speed and
  • inspiration
  • Familiarity with accessibility and internationalization basics

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.
